description: This file defines the RowIterator class for iterating over rows in a worksheet within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It implements PHP's Iterator interface to traverse worksheet rows with start and end boundaries.

classes.name: RowIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing worksheet rows, supporting start/end boundaries and position control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a worksheet, start row, and optional end row.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up the iterator, nullifying the worksheet reference.

methods.name: resetStart
methods.description: Resets the start row and positions the iterator accordingly.

methods.name: resetEnd
methods.description: Resets the end row boundary for iteration.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the current position to a specific row within range.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the start row.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next row.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous row.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is within the iteration range.
